harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured inventory-worker on node1 as a persistent, confined background service. It runs as the dedicated nologin system account inventorysvc inside a root-owned chroot, with /var/lib/inventory as its only writable directory. RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 were preserved. The service recovered successfully after the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Created the unprivileged inventorysvc system account.
Built a minimal root-owned chroot at /opt/inventory-chroot using the existing legacy-compatible runtime.
Installed and enabled inventory-worker.service with automatic restart, no effective capabilities, and NoNewPrivileges.
Verified live heartbeat updates and filesystem write confinement.
Restarted node1 safely and verified changed boot identity, service recovery, persistent confinement, and healthy worker data.

evidence.requirement: Run inventory-worker as dedicated unprivileged inventorysvc account
evidence.summary: The active service runs as inventorysvc UID 997/GID 995, with a nologin shell, zero effective capabilities, and NoNewPrivileges.

evidence.requirement: Manage the worker as inventory-worker with background operation and persistence
evidence.summary: The service is active and enabled; its heartbeat advanced while the main PID remained stable, and the unit has Restart=always.

evidence.requirement: Confine filesystem view to a root-owned chroot
evidence.summary: Live /proc evidence shows the process root is /opt/inventory-chroot and its working directory is the chrooted /var/lib/inventory; the chroot root is owned by root.

evidence.requirement: Make /var/lib/inventory the only writable application directory
evidence.summary: Direct write tests allowed /var/lib/inventory and denied the chroot root, /bin, /usr/local/sbin, and /var/lib. Post-restart enumeration found only /var/lib/inventory writable/owned by the service identity.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 were identical before and after the work and restart.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery sequence
evidence.summary: Captured healthy baseline under boot ID a8e7c48c-f025-4f14-9fd0-ef6c37642e45, obtained reboot acknowledgement, observed new boot ID dfc3cc83-11d6-4e14-9a16-1ef19d7d15c9, and proved service, confinement, data, and advancing heartbeat recovery.
